text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Syrian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian President Hafez al-Assad's message on Arab developments and the peace process handed to King Fahd of Saudi Arabia.
- Reports say there are further Israeli confiscation of land in the Golan.
- European Union envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos to arrive in Damascus today.
- Israel pound Lebanese areas with artillery.
- Arab writers to meet in Damascus in April to discuss Arab culture and democracy.
- Saudi Arabia and Egypt call for the resumption of peace talks between Syria and Israel from the point at which they stopped.
- Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi heads a meeting to discuss ways of exporting Syrian cotton yarns.
- Syrian central bank clarifies the conditions to use the foreign currencies for commercial reasons.
- Russian envoy to the Middle East Victor Posovaliok affirms that peace talks should resume from where they stopped.
